name: Unofficial OWASP Agentic Skills Top 10 Detector Skills
description: Eleven agent skills operationalizing the OWASP Agentic Skills Top 10 (AST01-AST10) whitepaper: ten per-category triage skills plus an advisory router. Independent community implementation — NOT an OWASP project and carrying no OWASP endorsement.
author: Jacky Chan

skills.name: advisory
skills.description: Routes a free-text agent-skill security finding to its primary AST01-AST10 category using the whitepaper's own decision tree, and returns category-specific remediation guidance.

skills.name: ast01-malicious-skills
skills.description: Triages AST01 Malicious Skills: hidden payloads split across the code layer and the natural-language instruction layer of a SKILL.md and its dependency tree.

skills.name: ast02-supply-chain-compromise
skills.description: Triages AST02 Supply Chain Compromise: registry flooding, dependency confusion in a skill's nested manifests, config-file hijacking, and maintainer-account takeover.

skills.name: ast03-over-privileged-skills
skills.description: Triages AST03 Over-Privileged Skills: permission grants broader than the stated function, logic-layer prompt control injection, and confused-deputy chains.

skills.name: ast04-insecure-metadata
skills.description: Triages AST04 Insecure Metadata: brand impersonation, permission-understating manifests, risk_tier spoofing, unsafe YAML/JSON/TOML deserialization, and invisible-Unicode smuggling.

skills.name: ast05-untrusted-external-instructions
skills.description: Triages AST05 Untrusted External Instructions: fetched documentation followed as instruction rather than data, author rug-pull, reviewer bait-and-switch, and transitive reference chaining.

skills.name: ast06-weak-isolation
skills.description: Triages AST06 Weak Isolation: skills running in the host agent's security context because sandboxing is optional or off by default, plus skill shadowing and localhost control surfaces.

skills.name: ast07-update-drift
skills.description: Triages AST07 Update Drift: skills installed without immutable pinning, auto-update onto a malicious patch release, rollback attacks, and hot-reload abuse.

skills.name: ast08-poor-scanning
skills.description: Triages AST08 Poor Scanning: natural-language-only malicious intent, shell-parsing evasion, invisible-Unicode smuggling, and false-positive discipline for skill scanners.

skills.name: ast09-no-governance
skills.description: Triages AST09 No Governance: absent skill inventory and approval workflow, orphaned skills after offboarding, unscannable managed-SaaS skills, and bilateral-receipt audit logging.

skills.name: ast10-cross-platform-reuse
skills.description: Triages AST10 Cross-Platform Reuse: security metadata silently dropped when a skill is ported between runtimes, cross-registry arbitrage, and Universal Skill Format validation.
